## Upstream changes 0.40.2 -> 0.40.3

**Verdict:** SAFE TO APPLY — the notes describe only CLI/background-task fixes, and the image config itself (user, entrypoint, command, ports, volumes, healthcheck, environment) is unchanged between the two versions.

### Breaking changes
- none found in the notes

### Variables
- none — no variable additions, removals or renames are mentioned, and `OLLAMA_INSTALL_MODELS` / `OLLAMA_IMAGE_VERSION` in the compose file and `.env.example` are unaffected

### Data and dependencies
- none introduced by this range. The background model-upgrade-and-backup mechanism described under "Model upgrades" in the 0.40.2 notes (models re-upgraded on first run, originals kept as backups, downgrading below 0.40 requires re-pulling) is a requirement the template already runs under at 0.40.2 — it is not new in this move. Notably, 0.40.3 itself states: "Paused background model upgrade for embedding and other request performance" — this pauses that existing mechanism rather than extending it, so it reduces rather than adds risk.

### Before applying
- none required beyond the normal pull/recreate of the `ollama` container. No migration, backup or config edit is called for by these notes.

### Notes read
- v0.40.3 (2026-10-11) — the release being moved to
- v0.40.2 (2026-10-08) — read only as the stated baseline, not as part of this change

## Upstream changes 0.11 -> 0.12.0

**Verdict:** NEEDS ATTENTION — major feature/security release with authentication, sharing-permission and tool-approval behaviour changes; no breaking change forces a config edit, but the Security Advisory and several permission-model fixes mean this cannot be treated as a routine bump.

### Breaking changes
- None stated explicitly as "breaking" in the notes, but several fixes change existing behaviour in ways that affect already-configured deployments:
  - "🔒 **Password changes sign out everywhere without Redis.** Changing a password, by the user or an administrator, now signs that account out on every device even on installations without Redis" — users will be logged out on next password change where they previously weren't.
  - "🕶️ **Enforced temporary chats hold on every route.** Users with Enforce Temporary Chat can no longer save chats by calling the chat API directly or through import, clone and fork" — any integration relying on the old looser behaviour breaks.
  - "🗒️ **Notes switch applies to the notes API.** Turning Notes off with "ENABLE_NOTES" ... now also refuses every notes API request" — if Notes was disabled in the UI but something was using the API, it now stops working.
  - "🎣 **Links no longer act on your behalf without asking.**" changes how `?q=`, `load-url`, `youtube`, `call=true`/`voice=true` links behave — any bookmarked/automated links that relied on auto-execution now require confirmation.
  - "🛡️ **Security Advisory**: This release includes security and access-control fixes. We recommend updating production deployments at your earliest convenience." — treat as a signal to upgrade promptly, not deferrable.

### Variables
- New optional variables introduced by this release (none required, all default off/unset): `AUDIO_REALTIME_ENABLED`, `AUDIO_REALTIME_OPENAI_API_BASE_URL`, `AUDIO_REALTIME_OPENAI_API_KEY`, `AUDIO_REALTIME_MODEL`, `AUDIO_REALTIME_VOICE`, `AUDIO_REALTIME_TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL`, `REALTIME_CALL_PROMPT_TEMPLATE`, `ENABLE_MFA`, `MFA_ALLOW_OAUTH_BYPASS`, `MFA_ALLOW_TRUSTED_HEADER_BYPASS`, `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH`, `TOOL_SEARCH_DEFER_THRESHOLD`, `TOOL_SEARCH_ALWAYS_LOADED`, `TOOL_SEARCH_DEFER_BUILTIN_TOOLS`, `WEBSOCKET_REDIS_ROOM_CHANNELS` (set false to restore old streaming behaviour), `TAVILY_SEARCH_DEPTH`, `ENABLE_TOOLS`, `ENABLE_FUNCTIONS`, `ENABLE_TOOL_SERVERS`, `REALTIME_TTS_PROMPT_TEMPLATE`.
- None of these appear in `.env.example`; none are required for the container to start. No variable is renamed or removed in the notes.
- `.env.example` and the compose file still pin `WEBUI_IMAGE_VERSION=0.11` (`.env.example`: `# WEBUI_IMAGE_VERSION=0.11`; compose: `${WEBUI_IMAGE_VERSION:-0.11@sha256:...}`) — this file must be edited to actually move to 0.12.0, it is not a notes concern but a deploy-mechanics one.

### Data and dependencies
- "📇 **Faster knowledge pages on PostgreSQL.** ... a new index covers that lookup and is created by a migration." — an automatic schema migration runs on first boot of 0.12.0 for PostgreSQL-backed deployments; this template uses SQLite (per the backup service's `webui.db` handling), so it does not apply here, but should be verified if anyone has switched the backing database.
- No new minimum version is stated for any companion service (Postgres, Redis, Milvus, etc.) in this notes excerpt beyond "Milvus 2.5 and newer" for the new native hybrid search feature — that is opt-in and not used by this template (no Milvus service present), so it does not affect the verdict.
- This template does not run Postgres, Redis, or Milvus — Ollama is the only companion service, and its version is unaffected by anything in these notes.

### Before applying
- Take a backup first regardless (the template's `backups` service covers `webui.db` and the data directory — confirm a recent successful cycle in its logs before upgrading).
- Edit `WEBUI_IMAGE_VERSION` (or `WEBUI_IMAGE_TAG`) to `0.12.0` with the correct digest — the compose file's default still pins `0.11`.
- If using request auditing, two-factor enforcement, or tool-approval "ask" mode, review behaviour after upgrade — multiple fixes change how these work (see Breaking changes).
- Warn users that a password change now force-logs-out all sessions, including on this Redis-less template.
- No manual data migration command is required for this SQLite-based template.

### Notes read
- v0.12.0 release notes (full Added/Fixed sections) as supplied.
- No UPGRADING, BREAKING_CHANGES or CHANGELOG section was supplied separately — only the release notes text above was available; nothing further to cross-check was provided.
- No "THE RELEASE THE TEMPLATE RUNS NOW" (0.11 baseline) notes were supplied, so no requirement could be excluded as already-true at the current version; all items above are reported as introduced by this range on the assumption the 0.11 baseline notes were not given.
